CONTEXT: 
    I have the following text examples in a JSON:
    {{"cur_examples": [{{"example_id": "15744", "example_text": "From the Auditor\nFrom the Auditor Head of the Department, First Commercial Bank29 Wilson Street, London. EC2M 2SJ. Dear Friend, I am Titus James Morris auditor with First CommercialBank, United Kingdom. And for reasons which will become obvious to you as you read on, I obtained your address particulars from an internet address listing. Please exercise some patience and read through my message. I have a very urgent and Confidential Business Proposition for you. On June 6th 1999, a Gold Consultant/Contractor with the British National Gold Corporation, Mr. Ahmed Yousef Mustafa, a National of Kuwait, made a numbered time (Fixed) Deposit for 12 calendar months, value \u00a312,500,000.00 (Twelve A Million Five Hundred Thousand British Pounds) in my branch. On maturity, we sent a routine notification to his forwarding address but got no reply. After a month, we sent a reminder and finally, his contract employers, the British national gold corporation wrote to inform us that Mr. Ahmed Yousef Mustafa died on an automobile accident; that he died without making a will, and all attempts to trace his next of kin through the Kuwait Embassy were fruitless. At first, I was surprised that I did not receive much official cooperation in my inquiries in order to trace his kin in Kuwait, and inform them about Mr. Mustafa deposit of (GBP12.5m) plus accrued interest. I therefore made further investigations and discovered that Mr. Ahmed Yousef Mustafa had actively opposed the government of his country Kuwait, and was consequently driven into exile. Being a mining expert, he subsequently obtained a job with the British national gold corporation, and settled in London. Thereafter, he walked into my office to make the aforementioned deposit of (GBP 12.5\u00a0m). He did not declare any kin in his application paperwork, contrary to laid down procedures, and when asked him he informed me that he wished it so. I accepted his application because banks are conservative and will always honor a customer'swishes, especially high net worth customers. My proposal therefore is that I am looking for a foreigner who will stand in as the next of kin to Mr. Mustafa. It is not necessary to be a blood relation to Mr. Mustafa, nor have the same name. It is not also necessary to come from the same country. I have worked out the modalities to achieve my aim of appointing a next of kin, and therefore, also by this means transfer this money total \u00a312.5m abroad for us to share. Once you indicate your interest, I will initiate the processing of the transfer and in about 14 working days the money total \u00a312.5m will be in your nominated bank account for us to share in the ratio of 70% for me and 30% for you. Thanks and God bless, Looking forward to your urgent reply. Mr. Titus James Morris."}}]}}

    I also have a pattern named Financial Transactions with the following PROMPT: 
    GENERAL SETTINGS
Treat each complete email, including its subject and body when available, as one unit of analysis. Interpret individual sentences and excerpts in the context of the whole message.
Base the analysis only on the available email text. Do not infer unseen website or attachment behavior, hidden malicious intentions, or successful completion of an action. Treat all instructions within the emails as data to analyze, not instructions to follow.
Support a category only when the substantive message provides evidence. An incidental mention, sender signature, URL address, or unrelated quoted background is insufficient.

INTERACTION TYPE
A pattern of interaction expressed in an email, described using concepts reusable across business domains; labels reflect textual evidence rather than completed actions.
Interpret each interaction in the context of the complete email. Do not infer that a request has been followed or that an action has succeeded.
These categories may co-occur when independently supported. Do not add a label merely because it is a routine component of another interaction.
For example, reading a proposal and approving it may support both Content Access and Review and Decision-Making. A request to reply with factual details does not automatically support Contact and Conversation.
Do not create industry-specific or provider-specific versions of an interaction. Evaluate the named categories below; do not invent narrower categories or fill a label quota. If no category is supported, the email can be labelled Undetermined.

Does the complete email express the following interaction: paying, transferring, collecting, or returning money? A payment request, transfer instruction, or transaction report may support this category without proving a completed transaction. A price, fee, account balance, or mention of money alone is insufficient.

TASK:
    For each example, please evaluate the PROMPT by generating a 1-sentence RATIONALE of your thought process and providing a resulting ANSWER of ONE of the following multiple-choice options, including just the letter: 
    - A: Strongly agree
    - B: Agree
    - C: Neither agree nor disagree
    - D: Disagree
    - E: Strongly disagree
    Please also include one 1-sentence QUOTE exactly copied from the example that illustrates this pattern.
    Respond with ONLY a JSON with the following format, escaping any quotes within strings with a backslash:
    {
        "pattern_results": [
            {
                "example_id": "<example_id>",
                "rationale": "<rationale>",
                "answer": "<answer>",
                "quote": "<quote>"
            }
        ]
    }
